texts: Write a doha about my new bike and the thrill of the first ride down the empty road.
doha: new bike
Compose a doha about a shiny red motorbike, its engine purring, the wind in my face and a whole Sunday of open road ahead.
need a couplet about getting my first bike
A verse for my new bike, who stood so gleaming in the parking lot this morning that I forgot to be nervous about the helmet, the traffic, and the long ride to work ahead of me.
Write a doha about exam results coming out tomorrow.
doha on board exam results
Compose a doha about the nervous morning when results are announced, the refreshed website, the trembling fingers, and the sudden cheer in the house when the marks finally appear on the screen.
need a couplet about passing my exams
a verse for my results day
Write a doha about mango season in summer.
doha: mangoes
Compose a doha about the first Alphonso of the season, golden and juicy, dripping down the wrist, with the whole family gathered around the table for slices and laughter.
need a couplet about mango season
A verse for my favourite summer fruit, sticky fingers, yellow juice, and a plate that empties far too quickly while the afternoon heat hums outside.
Write a doha about a Monday morning.
doha on Monday blues
Compose a doha about the alarm that rings too early, the half-open eyes, the tea gone cold, and the long sigh of a Monday morning before the inbox fills up.
need a couplet about hating Mondays
a verse for my sleepy Monday commute
Write a doha about my phone battery dying at two percent.
doha: low battery
Compose a doha about the red warning on the screen, the frantic search for a charger, and the sinking feeling when the phone goes dark right in the middle of an important call.
need a couplet about my phone dying again
A verse for my poor phone that survives only until the exact moment I need the map, the ticket and the call all at once, leaving me stranded and sighing.
Write a doha about my morning cutting chai.
doha: masala chai
Compose a doha about a steaming glass of ginger tea ordered on a rainy evening, the clink of glasses, the steam curling up, and the gossip that goes along with every sip.
need a couplet about ordering chai
a verse for my second cup of tea today
Write a doha about the wifi going down.
doha: no internet
Compose a doha about the router blinking red, the spinning loading circle, and the whole family suddenly staring at each other because the internet has vanished in the middle of a movie.
need a couplet about slow wifi
A verse for my wifi that works perfectly all day and then dies exactly when the video meeting begins, leaving me waving at a frozen screen with a hopeful, desperate smile.
Write a doha about my cousin getting promoted.
doha on a promotion party
Compose a doha about the sweet news of a promotion, the congratulations on the phone, the box of sweets passed around, and the big smile on my cousin's face at dinner.
need a couplet to congratulate my cousin on his new job title
a verse for my cousin's big day at the office
Write a doha about losing my umbrella again.
doha: lost umbrella
Compose a doha about the third umbrella I have left on a bus this month, and the sudden downpour that always arrives right after I step outside without one.
need a couplet about forgetting my umbrella
A verse for my missing umbrella, which vanished somewhere between the office and the bus stop and probably now keeps a stranger dry while I walk home soaked and grumbling.
Write a doha about my alarm clock refusing to ring.
doha: broken alarm
Compose a doha about the alarm that stayed silent, the sun already high, the frantic dash to get dressed and the breathless arrival at the office twenty minutes after everyone else.
need a couplet about oversleeping
a verse for the alarm that betrayed me this morning
